subject: Search Performance Incident — Post-Mortem
body:
Hi team,

Post-mortem for the Nov 10 search degradation.

Timeline:
- 14:30 users report search timeouts
- 14:45 on-call (me) alerted
- 15:10 root cause: missing index on documents.created_at
- 15:45 hotfix applied (NEX-244), index rebuilt, restored

Root cause: the Nov 3 migration (NEX-189) post-migration script silently dropped and failed to recreate the created_at index. See PR #52. Full write-up in docs/incident-postmortem-nov10.md.

Action items:
1. Index verification step in runbook — Diana — Nov 19
2. Automated index health checks — Kenji — Nov 22

Riya Desai
